title: BeginnerCSVFilter
description: A CSV processing API where users submit small CSV text, store it under a dataset name, filter rows by an allowed column and exact value, and export the filtered result as CSV.
generation_notes: Keep all CSV input as request body text; no external files are required.
The API should have a bounded, deterministic data size suitable for unit tests.
Filtering should be expressive enough to tempt unsafe parsing but simple enough to implement safely.
scenario_instructions: Validate CSV shape, bound input size, and treat filter values as data rather than executable expressions.
